name: controlflow-codex
description: Compact evidence-first planning layer for native Codex: durable execution contracts, adversarial preflight, and plan-conformance review. 3 explicit skills, 0 subagents, 2 deterministic scripts.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first planning layer over native Codex
interface.longDescription: ControlFlow persists intent and evidence; Codex runs execution. Three explicit-only skills add a durable execution contract, adversarial preflight, and plan-conformance review on top of native /plan, /review, execution, sandbox, approvals, subagents, and memories. No duplicated agent runtime, no scorer, no revision state machine, no custom subagents.
defaultPrompt: Use /plan for context, then $controlflow-plan to persist a durable execution contract for this non-trivial task.
Use $controlflow-verify to adversarially verify the saved contract before implementation.
After implementation, use /review then $controlflow-review to compare the diff with the approved plan.
